mode.title: Export mode
mode.description: Use `list` for saved lead lists (`/sales/lists/people/...`) or `search` for Sales Navigator people search URLs.

listUrl.title: Lead list URL or ID
listUrl.description: Full Sales Navigator lead list URL or numeric list ID. Required when mode is `list`.

searchUrl.title: People search URL
searchUrl.description: Full Sales Navigator people search URL. Required when mode is `search`.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Maximum number of leads to export (1–2000). Each lead triggers one Harvest profile lookup (+ company when available).

unipileApiKey.title: Unipile API key
unipileApiKey.description: Unipile API key for Sales Navigator list/search export. Env: UNIPILE_API_KEY.

unipileAccountId.title: Unipile LinkedIn account ID
unipileAccountId.description: LinkedIn seat connected in Unipile. Env: UNIPILE_ACCOUNT_ID.

harvestApiKey.title: Harvest API key
harvestApiKey.description: HarvestAPI key for full LinkedIn profile enrichment. Env: HARVEST_API_KEY.

harvestBatchSize.title: Harvest batch size
harvestBatchSize.description: Parallel Harvest profile/company requests per batch (3–15).
